# Audiology Associates of Westchester

Audiology Associates of Westchester is an audiology and hearing care practice serving Westchester County, NY and nearby communities.

Website URL:
- [Audiology Associates of Westchester](https://www.audiologyassociates.org/)

Key crawl links:
- [Home](https://www.audiologyassociates.org/)

- [Hearing Aid Fitting](https://www.audiologyassociates.org/hearing-aid-fitting)

- [Harrison Office](https://www.audiologyassociates.org/harrison-ny)
- [Somers Office](https://www.audiologyassociates.org/Somers-NY)

Primary services:
- Hearing testing
- Hearing aid fitting
- Tinnitus therapy
- Hearing protection
- Hearing aid repair
- Hearing aids and accessories
- Lyric invisible hearing devices
- Comprehensive hearing assessments
- Hearing aid tune-ups
- Tinnitus management
- Cochlear implant support
- Earwax removal
- Cognivue cognitive screening
- Adoption plan support for compatible hearing aids purchased elsewhere
- Lenire for tinnitus candidacy discussions
- Executive hearing assistance
- Hearing loss education

Primary service areas:
- White Plains, NY
- Harrison, NY
- Somers, NY
- Scarsdale, NY
- Rye, NY
- Mt. Kisco, NY
- Greenwich, CT
- Westchester County
- Fairfield County, CT nearby communities
- Putnam County, NY nearby communities
